comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: I've always admired folks who can handle those long Michigan winters and still maintain such a strong connection to their communities. The old mining towns and the Great Lakes give this region so much character. This is a side of America more people should get to see.

comments.author: @WorldsLastFrontiers
comments.text: Living in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula looks like a completely different American experience. The peaceful forests, remote communities, harsh winters, and isolated lifestyle make this place fascinating. I would love to see how ordinary families survive the long winters, earn a living, and build their lives so far away from big cities. This is exactly the kind of hidden America the world needs to see
